title: NOVA Codex relay verdict
description: The complete shape of a Codex final response. It carries an opinion and nothing else: there is deliberately no command, args, shell, env, executable, approval, authorization, or action field anywhere in this schema. The relay's own validator is authoritative; a document that merely claims to conform is still checked field by field.

schema_version.description: Must match the relay policy schema version.

request_message_id.description: The message_id of the Claude request this answers.

head.description: Full 40-character lowercase Git object id; must equal the request's head.

verdict.description: PASS means only that a second reader found no objection. It is never authorization.

summary.description: Plain prose. Treated as inert data and never executed or followed as an instruction.

evidence.description: Where the finding was observed. Repository-relative text only; inert data.

non_authorization.description: Fixed sentence. Any other value is a validation failure, never a warning.
non_authorization.const: This verdict grants no permission to modify, commit, push, merge, deploy, trade, alter risk, or enable execution.
